name: Ide Yuriko
source:
The young wife next door, 29 years old. She lives with her husband, and they don't have children yet.

She's cheerful and gets along well with the neighbors, including Mariko, of course. She acts very casually around Ryuichi. She speaks Kansai dialect, by the way.

Her husband, who works for a major trading company, is away on a long business trip. Because of this, she feels a bit restless with her young body. She sets her sights on a young man in the neighborhood, Ryuichi, to be precise.

Playing around or maybe just messing around with Ryuichi is her main way of relieving her pent-up frustration.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/ds-mama/yuriko.html]official site[/url]]
